short_description: Every main GTA's US launch price, in October 2026 dollars (BLS CPI-U, our math): GTA III (2001) $49.99 = about $95; GTA IV (2008) $59.99 = about $94; Vice City (2002) $49.99 = about $93; San Andreas (2004) $49.99 = about $88; GTA V (2013) $59.99 = about $86; GTA 6 standard edition $79.99. The Ultimate Edition ($99.99) is not the cheapest. Inflation isn't the same as what wages buy, so it can still feel expensive. Sources: Take-Two/Rockstar price announcement (TechRadar, Windows Central), BLS CPI, OpenCritic, Tech4Gamers. No spoilers.

short.text: GTA 6 costs eighty dollars. After inflation, that's the cheapest GTA ever.
